# NivaTV

> NivaTV is a premium Indian live TV streaming app for Android devices. It provides instant access to 500+ live television channels across Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, Kannada, Marathi, Punjabi, Gujarati, and other regional languages.

## Overview
- **Platform:** Android 6.0+ (Mobile, Tablet, Android TV)
- **Channels:** 500+ live HD and SD channels
- **Genres:** News, Movies, Sports (IPL & Cricket), Entertainment, Music, Kids, Devotional, Regional
- **Payment & License:** Instant digital license delivery via Razorpay (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Cards). No auto-renewal or recurring hidden charges. Free 1-day trial available.

- [Home](https://nivatv.luxomall.in/): Official homepage with features, channel highlights, and live preview.
- [Plans & Pricing](https://nivatv.luxomall.in/pricing): Subscription plans starting from ₹0 (1-day free trial), monthly and yearly licenses.

- [Browse Channel Library](https://nivatv.luxomall.in/browse): Search and filter available Indian channels by category and language.
- [Customer Support](https://nivatv.luxomall.in/support): WhatsApp, Telegram, and email support for license activation and streaming assistance.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nivatv.luxomall.in/privacy): Privacy terms and data protection policies.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://nivatv.luxomall.in/terms): Service terms and license usage conditions.
